starter.title: Build your next app with Eazo
starter.subtitle: You now have a clean foundation with auth, data access, and platform integrations ready for your product.

readDocs.title: Read the docs
readDocs.desc: Open AGENTS.md and README.md to understand the template architecture.

replacePage.title: Replace this page
replacePage.desc: Move your product UI into src/components and keep page.tsx thin.

firstFeature.title: Build your first feature
firstFeature.desc: Add API routes under src/app/api and call them from typed helpers.

translations.title: Add translations
translations.desc: Edit en-US / zh-CN strings in src/i18n/locales. LanguageSwitcher and I18nProvider in layout.tsx are already wired.

nextCommand.title: Next command
nextCommand.desc: Start developing and iterate in real time.

req.title: Structured Requirements
req.empty: Paste the show brief, or click "Load demo case" to start.
req.placeholder: e.g. 3-min tech brand opening show, theme "From Individual to Symbiosis", 12 dancers, main LED, two side entries, emotion from restraint to burst…
req.materialsPlaceholder: Supporting materials: client requirements, run sheet, cast details, stage constraints, or references.
req.creativePlaceholder: My creative direction: emotional arc, visual taste, key moments, or transitions.
req.textFilesOnly: Only TXT and Markdown files are supported for now.
req.pendingHint: Answer these questions one by one. You can leave unknown items blank and refine them later.

project.box: Project materials · used by every generation
project.name: Project name (optional; it can be inferred)
project.director: Director / client requirements: constraints and non-negotiables
project.program: Program material: content, duration, order, and more
project.creative: My creative intent: arc, visual mood, key images, transitions

dir.title: Creative Directions
dir.selectedHint: Selected. Refine it first, then build the execution plan.
dir.confirm: Confirm direction and generate Cue sheet

plan.title: Show Proposal Table
plan.empty: Pick a creative direction and the time-based proposal table will appear here.
plan.note: Click any cell to edit; the formation column is a schematic.
plan.workingToast: Turning the creative direction into an execution plan
plan.workingToastDescription: The Cue sheet will appear in the centre of the workbench when it is ready.
plan.workingInline: Building the first plan. You can still review or refine the selected direction.
plan.workingDescription: Turning the direction into executable time blocks, stage notes, and departmental collaboration details. It will unfold here when ready.

performance.title: Performance Treatment
performance.done: Treatment generated. Review and edit it.
performance.generateCue: Confirm treatment and generate full Cue sheet

fb.title: Director Feedback
fb.placeholder: e.g. Change to 8 dancers; make the last 30s more powerful; no handheld props.

prop.title: Impact Analysis · Change Preview
prop.hint: Confirm one item at a time. After a new version is built, remaining impacts are analysed again.

impact.revising: Building the new version and reassessing…
impact.complete: No impacts remain to confirm in this round.

persistence.loadFailed: This project could not be loaded
persistence.unavailable: Saving is unavailable; run the Supabase migration first

department.title: Department Requirements
department.hint: Choose a department to review its work by Cue. Select an item to focus that Cue.

timeline.title: Cue Timeline
timeline.hint: Choose a Cue to review its execution focus. Edit the timecode here; edit other details in the proposal table below.
